name: Integer
definition: A whole number or its negative, including zero. Integers have no fractional part.
example: −3, 0, and 12 are integers; 1/3 and 0.56 are not.

name: Prime number
definition: A whole number greater than 1 with exactly two positive factors: 1 and itself.
example: 2, 3, 5, and 7 are prime. 1 is neither prime nor composite.

name: Composite number
definition: A whole number greater than 1 with more than two positive factors.

name: Even number
definition: An integer divisible by 2 with no remainder.

name: Odd number
definition: An integer that is not divisible by 2 with no remainder.

name: Decimal number
definition: A number written using base-10 place value, often with a decimal point to show a fractional part.

name: Decimal point
definition: The symbol that separates the whole-number part from the fractional part in decimal notation.
example: In 12.34, the point separates 12 from 34 hundredths.

name: Decimal place
definition: A position to the right of the decimal point; its value is a power of one tenth.
example: In 0.47, 4 is in the tenths place and 7 is in the hundredths place.

name: Base-10 / decimal system
definition: A number system using the digits 0–9. Each place is worth ten times the place immediately to its right.

name: Rational number
definition: A number that can be written as a/b, where a and b are integers and b is not zero. Its decimal form terminates or eventually repeats.

name: Irrational number
definition: A real number that cannot be written as a ratio of two integers. Its decimal form never terminates or eventually repeats.

name: Expanded form
definition: A way to write a number as a sum of its place-value parts.

name: Factor
definition: A number multiplied by another to make a product. A whole-number factor divides a whole number with no remainder.

name: Multiple
definition: The result of multiplying a number by an integer.

name: Whole number
definition: One of the numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, and so on.
example: 0 and 25 are whole numbers; −1 and 2.5 are not.

name: Natural number
definition: A counting number: 1, 2, 3, and so on. Some books include 0, so check the convention being used.
example: 1, 2, and 3 are natural numbers under either convention.

name: Digit
definition: A single symbol used to write numbers. The base-10 digits are 0 through 9.

name: Place value
definition: The value a digit has because of its position in a number.

name: Standard form
definition: In basic place-value work, the usual way to write a number using digits. The phrase has other meanings in later math.

name: Fraction
definition: A number written as a/b, where the denominator b is not zero. It can describe parts of a whole or a quotient.
example: 3/4 represents three of four equal parts.

name: Numerator
definition: The top number in a fraction.

name: Denominator
definition: The bottom number in a fraction; it cannot be zero. For equal parts of a whole, it tells how many parts make one whole.

name: Mixed number
definition: A whole number together with a proper fraction.

name: Sum
definition: The result of addition.

name: Difference
definition: The result of subtraction.

name: Product
definition: The result of multiplication.

name: Quotient
definition: The result of division.

name: Remainder
definition: The amount left after dividing whole numbers into equal groups, when the answer is expressed as a whole-number quotient and a remainder.

name: Equivalent
definition: Having the same value.

name: Variable
definition: A symbol, often a letter, representing a number or quantity.

name: Expression
definition: A mathematical phrase made of numbers, variables, and operations, without an equals sign stating an equation.

name: Equation
definition: A statement that two expressions have equal values.

name: Coefficient
definition: A numerical factor multiplying a variable or variable expression.
example: In 5x, the coefficient of x is 5.

name: Constant
definition: A quantity with a fixed value. A constant term contains no variable.

name: Exponent
definition: A number indicating how many times a base is used as a factor when the exponent is a positive integer.

name: Absolute value
definition: A number’s distance from zero on the number line. It is always nonnegative.

name: Percent
definition: A ratio expressed per hundred.

name: Order of operations
definition: The agreed order for evaluating expressions: grouping, exponents, multiplication and division from left to right, then addition and subtraction from left to right.
